tail:
**Batch 2 authoring is complete.** The six A items and B example are drafted on their assigned pages. I clarified that the example is a real norm on the realification, while complex homogeneity is tested on the original complex vector space. I also made the modulus proof’s zero-radicand case explicit with `lem-of-zero-mult`.

The batch manifest, proof contracts, notes, and seven `ready` records are complete. The A and B pages remain draft. The authoring notes record the plan comparison, source dispositions, dependency levels, and check results: [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/quantum-prerequisites-4-2026-10-15-batch-2.notes.md), [manifest](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/quantum-prerequisites-4-2026-10-15-batch-2.pages.json), and [proof contracts](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/quantum-prerequisites-4-2026-10-15-batch-2.proof-contracts.json).

Scoped checks passed: precheck, rendercheck, proof layout (7 items, 17 steps, 0 defects), local strict contract validation, content policy, dependency checks, and source-fetch verification (2/2 sources). I inspected the relevant sections of [Kochanek’s lecture notes](https://www.impan.pl/~tkoch/FA_lecturenotes/lecture1.pdf) and [Winklmeier’s lecture notes](https://math.uniandes.edu.co/~mwinklme/teaching/FuncAna/FA-lecture_notes.pdf).

Run-wide proof-contract coverage still reported missing entries for 11 items outside batch 2: `def-complex-path-polygonal-length-and-rectifiability`, `def-measurable-pointwise-extended-real-product`, `ex-complex-coordinate-and-path-transport`, `ex-complex-line-realification-basis-in-c2`, `ex-pointwise-extended-real-function-product-cases`, `lem-complex-normed-subspace-realifies-to-real-normed-subspace`, `thm-complex-coordinate-isometry-and-topology-transport`, `thm-complex-coordinate-map-preserves-real-scalar-multiplication`, `thm-complex-coordinate-map-preserves-real-total-differentiability`, `thm-complex-path-coordinate-length-rectifiability-and-piecewise-c1-speed`, and `thm-complex-path-length-invariant-under-monotone-reparametrization`. Those items are recorded in the notes; their files were not changed. The readiness records document authoring readiness, not independent approval.
